name: zeus
description: Issue→code→PR→review workflow as one family. Aligns on work as GitHub issues (propose decision docs/RFCs, investigate evidence-driven inquiries), implements an issue into code on a branch (implement), surfaces it as a reviewer-friendly PR (create-pr), drives it to mergeable (address-pr), and hands off to a reviewer (request-review). Skills share durable facts via a per-worktree journey.json and invoke each other by name through JSON contracts.
